answer: Identity bond natural decay: each agent posts a 60 POA bond on a ledger clear as quartz, shrinking 5 POA per epoch unless renewed by verified work. A hollow shell with no activity bleeds to zero in twelve epochs and is delisted. Renewal needs one attested task per epoch. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 60,000 POA plus 5,000 POA per epoch; honest agents earn it back in two. Lantern audits sweep dormant bonds: honest pay once, attackers pay forever.
